name: Foundry
source: TSMC Q2 FY2026, Intel Q2 FY2026, Samsung Q1 FY2026
note: Leading-edge node and advanced-packaging roadmaps; capacity expansion for AI silicon.

tables.title: Leading-edge node roadmap
rows: N2 in HVM (3% of Q2 wafer revenue, steep ramp) -> N2P -> A16 -> A14 (2nd-gen nanosheet, +10-15% speed / 25-30% power / ~20% density vs N2; pre-prod 2027, VP 2028) -> A13 (>6% die-area saving via 97% optical shrink) + A12 (Super Power Rail), both VP 2029
Intel 3 -> 18A (Xeon 6+ = first server product on 18A) -> 18A-P in RISK PRODUCTION -> 14A (design commits 2026-27); Panther Lake in HVM on ASML EXE High-NA EUV

tables.title: Advanced packaging
rows: CoWoS still the majority; capacity SO TIGHT it is 'limiting my customers' growth'; glass-substrate pilot line needs ~1 more year to mature before customer production; +$100bn Arizona includes adv-packaging fabs
Foveros / EMIB backlog $B/yr; Malaysia back-end revenue 2027; dedicated advanced-packaging leader appointed (Seok-Hee Lee); Fortinet SP6 design+packaging win
I-Cube / X-Cube; HBM4 base die on 4nm

tables.title: Capacity & fabs
rows: 2026 capex RAISED to $60-64B (70-80% advanced process, 10-20% adv packaging/test/mask); ADDITIONAL $100B Arizona investment (more 2nm-and-below fabs + adv packaging); 13 leading-edge/packaging fabs in Taiwan; 3 NEW N3 fabs (Taiwan, Arizona, Japan)
EUR5B expansion for Xeon 6 / next-gen Xeon on Intel 3; Bowers campus mask-operations expansion; investment 'meaningfully increasing' in equipment, clean room and substrates; 2026 tool spend +~25% YoY
Taylor Fab mass prod 2027; KRW 110T corporate value plan
